question: Were exactly the failed proof obligations repaired, on exactly the families they failed on?
grantsNothing: This is a repairer's return. It issues no verdict, promotes no family, proves none, opens no commercial route and weakens no gate. Every family below goes to a verifier that neither built nor repaired it.
doesNotReplace: fable-fa-repair-return.json in this directory is an earlier FIX01 dispatch's return at base ee5bdb5b, preserved unchanged beside this file rather than overwritten. rt1-repair-return.json is likewise preserved.
whatThisLaneWasGranted: The generated FIX01 assignment names fifteen families. This worker was granted and asserted only the ten exact families in the current repair brief. The five additional generated families were not claimed, read, modified or returned.
howEachRowWasMeasured: Every current family returned CLAIM_OK before family content was read. Old and current family/route JSON subsets were canonically projected and SHA-256 compared before repair. Nine source-free families completed two deterministic --no-raster builds; AR's two full-build attempts correctly touched no output because its unchanged official binaries are not mounted, so its receipt-only repair was checked by two exact PDF rehash passes. Every family then ran its exact focused completeness command.
aboutTheNineCounters: All ten focused completeness runs returned PASS_COMPLETE with every one of the nine counters zero. No substantive packet byte changed; canonical and boundary hashes and lengths remain exact, so the existing exact-hash raster bindings remain the applicable visual evidence, subject to central re-admission after independent verification.
rasterNotRun: No local raster was run because no canonical or boundary PDF byte changed. Each row records the existing RASTER_PASS receipt that binds the unchanged hashes; the central queue still marks those receipts historical-only while repair and independent re-verification are pending.

rows.standingVerdict: VF12 (VT-F), FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED on ROUTE_IDENTITY, KNOWN_PREFILLS and SERVICE
rows.decisiveDefect: The participant page and the field map printed route key obligation:track-pathway:VT:vt_exp_decriminalized:expungement-of-decriminalized-conduct, which occurs in no route record. A participant.email write was dropped on stipulation 200-00132A with no refusal recorded and the instructions asserting it had been filled in. The packet sent the participant to 'ask the same clerk' who must be served, when the census names the recipient.
rows.whatWasDone: Nothing. All three are closed at this base. Measured here: the invented route key returns zero hits anywhere in the family directory; production-field-map.json routeKeys and product-wiring.json routeKey/routeKeys all carry the census key obligation:track-pathway:VT:vt_exp_decriminalized:adult-conviction-expungement-narrow-statutory-route, and the participant footer prints a readable route description rather than a third machine key, which is the settled convention at 7e8975628 ('print the route a person can read, keep the machine id in the manifests'). reports/rendered-artifacts.json now records prefillsRefusedByTheFinalizer for 200-00132A field 34i participant.email with reason value_exceeds_widget_width_at_minimum_font and the value held, and participant-instructions.md discloses it in a 'Boxes too small for a long value' table. A 'Who gets served' section states the census recipient verbatim -- whichever office prosecuted the offence, the State's Attorney or the Attorney General, unless that office authorises the other to act under 7602(a)(3) -- and adds that a signed stipulation is not service.
rows.alsoChecked: This family was one of the ten in FABLE-VC's stale-wiring-digest list. Its product-wiring component digest 3bd92e341850... matches the bytes at this base.

rows.decisiveDefect: Both fixtures wrote Theft in the Third Degree, Malicious Mischief in the Third Degree and Criminal Trespass in the Second Degree under CrRLJ 09.0800's printed line 'I was convicted of the following cannabis offense(s):', inside a declaration signed under penalty of perjury, and carried the same values onto CrRLJ 09.0870 paragraph 3. The field map declared no cannabis constraint at all.
rows.whatWasDone: Nothing. Both halves VT-A required are closed at this base. Measured here: the three non-cannabis strings occur zero times in reports/actual-writes.json and zero times in reports/rendered-artifacts.json. The shared Washington persona still carries them -- correctly, since the seven families on CrRLJ 09.0100's generic caption 'the following offense/s' are untouched -- and CHARGE_CONSTRAINTS in scripts/build-census-v1-wa_blake_vacatur_and_lfo_refund-set.mjs overrides them for this family alone with four offences taken from the registry's own mechanism for track wa_vac_cannabis. production-field-map.json now emits valueConstraints with mustMatch over matter.charges[].charge on both governed forms, matching cannabis, marijuana or marihuana case-insensitively, with the printed governing lines re-read from the pinned source at build time, so a runtime filling the map finds the rule rather than inferring it from the family name.

rows.decisiveDefect: VT-C measured seven words of the participant's own name and street address outside the 612x792 page box on four pages of the boundary fixture, including the Cover Letter to Court, while reports/actual-writes.json called the same writes fit; three declared writes producing no ink with nothing disclosing it; a proposed-order row carrying an arrest date beside an empty docket cell; and participant-instructions.md answering none of FILING_DESTINATION, FEE_AND_WAIVER, SERVICE or SELF_HELP_STOP behind a catch-all sentence.
rows.whatWasDone: Nothing. All eight are closed at this base. Re-measured here from the delivered bytes, not from a report: pdftotext -bbox-layout word rectangles against each page's own MediaBox give 0 words outside the page box on the canonical AND 0 on the boundary, against VT-C's 7. On boundary page 31 row (1) the arrest date is now withheld together with the docket number, so the row is left whole, while the canonical writes both cells. ExpungeCntyName now carries decision 'refuse' with requiredBeforeFiling true and blankTreatment REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, its reason stating that the platform holds no exact fact for the filing-venue caption -- so no residence county was written into it, which is what VT-C forbade -- and 'County (where you are filing) (source field: ExpungeCntyName)' now appears in the packet's required-before-filing list. arrest1CaseNum, arrest1Dt and dismissOff1 are each disclosed in a 'Values this platform holds but did not print' table with the reason and the fixture measured on. The catch-all sentence returns zero hits, and the packet now carries 'Where to file', 'What it costs to file', 'Who must be served' and 'Where self-help ends' sections sourced to the enclosed kit's own pages and the track registry.

rows.whyStopped: COMPONENT_SET cannot be repaired in a repair lane and was not. The delivered 15-page bundle prints 'Take out this page and insert your non-conviction Facts / Findings / Exhibit pages (from the Non Conviction Insert Forms)' on three of its own pages, and no bound source supplies those pages. VF09 is explicit that no repair lane may compose substitutes for them; this lane composed none, invented no facts pages, and left the finding open. It closes only when a source lane acquires the Coalition for Court Access Non Conviction Insert Forms and binds them to this family.
rows.whatWasDone: One measured correction inside VF09's own repair scope: the Facts placeholder's page citation. participant-instructions.md, production-field-map.json and reports/missing-companion-forms.json all placed it on 'page 5'. Measured from the delivered bytes with pdftotext, the three placeholders are on pages 4, 10 and 11; the Findings and Exhibit citations were already right and only the Facts one was off, on the page a participant is told to look at first. Corrected in scripts/build-census-v1-in_section1_petition-set.mjs so all three records now say what the bytes say.
